SessionRunnerLLM boundary and logical-step policy
|
|-- drain invocation
|   |-- Local state: force, continuing, step, entering, stepped, promotable
|   |-- Entry: check work; await plugins; settle stale compactions/tool calls
|   |-- advanceToStep closure
|   |   |-- Closed location -> close transport; return Reloaded
|   |   |-- -> SessionInbox serialized inspection and control delivery
|   |   |   |-- move -> close transport; publish Moved; return Moved
|   |   |   `-- compaction -> preview history; explicit compact; inspect again
|   |   |-- Input boundary: queue on next turn; steer during continuation
|   |   |   |-- -> prepareContext: await plugins, select, prepare instructions
|   |   |   |-- -> promote eligible inbox input; load context
|   |   |   `-- -> titles FiberMap: generate title without blocking the model
|   |   `-- No work: idle hook after a model step may admit more input
|   |       `-- Otherwise Complete; no execution ownership lives here
|   `-- Loop: advanceToStep -> runStep -> increment step -> next boundary
|       `-- Can cross continuation and queued-turn boundaries in one drain
`-- runStep invocation (logical policy; not the attempt scope)
    |-- Local state: assistant ID, retry helper, recovery flags, loaded context
    |-- Context loop
    |   |-- First context from boundary; retries reload without promoting input
    |   |-- -> SessionCompaction.estimatePrompt / compact(auto) / precompute
    |   |   `-- Completed compaction -> fresh assistant ID and reload
    |   `-- -> baseTranscript -> context.request.primary
    |       |-- History + instructions + agent/model + selected tools
    |       |-- Plugin hooks shape request; transport supplies bound options
    |       `-- Step limit: toolChoice=none; keep tool definitions
    |-- -> SessionStep.attempt(prepared request + callbacks)
    |   |-- executeTool wrapper waits for plugin activation
    |   |-- retry callback -> retry helper + request retry hook
    |   `-- recoverOverflow callback -> compaction before durable output
    `-- Outcome handling
        |-- Completed -> continuation flag; precompute summary before idle
        |-- Retry -> wait; optionally replace assistant ID; reload context
        |-- RecoverFull -> retry with continuation recovery disabled
        |-- Compacted -> disable overflow recovery; new assistant ID; reload
        `-- OutputLimit -> bounded continuation or synthetic instruction
